description: Every source kind composing, with readable pins. single: one prose source, verbatim. pair: two
prose sources joined by one blank line, in sources order. topics: a for over an input, one
'## <title>' block per item in input order, named by the input's labelField; the inner if takes
no branch for 'Social history', so that item has no block and the blocks close up around it.
sections: a for over node.plan's list (labelField title) whose item text is an inner for's
blocks (labelField heading), so each section heading is followed by its point headings.
summary: a while (checkFirst, until) that runs two passes; only the last pass's text composes.
plan: an if that took its branch, composed as its returned node's text. tone_line: a case that
took its 'formal' branch. tally: a let of type text, composed as its plain text.

inputs.consult_draft: Margaret Okafor, 64, seen for breathlessness on exertion. Echo shows mild aortic stenosis. Review in six months. (Fictional.)

outputs.draft_topic:0: History paragraph: breathless on exertion for a year.
outputs.draft_summary:2: Summary, second draft, naming the aortic valve.
outputs.draft_plan: Plan paragraph: repeat echo in six months.
outputs.formal_line: We remain at your disposal for any questions.
